indicator_name: Household debt burden (IMF Financial Soundness Indicators): debt to GDP, debt to disposable income, debt service to income
description: Долговая нагрузка домашних хозяйств (МВФ, показатели финансовой устойчивости): долг к ВВП, долг к располагаемому доходу, обслуживание долга к доходу
methodology: IMF FSIC, sector S14 (households), quarterly 2008 Q1 … 2024 Q1 (the dataflow stops there, like the deposit-taker FSIs of NBK form 314). FSI179 household debt / GDP (2023 Q4 15.31), FSI157 household debt / disposable income (80.89), FSI85 debt service and principal / income (2019 Q4 4.33, 2023 Q4 5.49). Dated at the end of the quarter. After 2024 Q1: LOANS_STOCK_BY_PURPOSE (HH) or BANK_LOANS_STB_HOUSEHOLDS against GDP; the NBK's Financial Stability Report quotes 17.5 % of GDP and debt service 5.9 % of income for 2025 (PDF only).
